capabilities: Suggest tags that co-occur with the typed tag
Insert a suggested tag with Shift+Enter, Tab, or Enter
Chain suggestions after each added tag
Count shared notes per tag pair (Pro)
Restrict counting to the current folder and set list length (Pro)
extras: Freemium: Pro features (counts, folder-scoped counting, list length) need a GitHub Sponsors payment and device-flow sign-in. Free features make no network requests. After updates it opens a promo tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; this can be disabled in settings. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
problem: Obsidian offers no completion for tags, so recalling which tags you already use together requires searching or memorizing them.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($15 total or $5/month to theluckystrike)

summary: Tag suggestion box that, after you type a tag, lists the tags that most often appear with it in your vault and inserts the one you pick.
